title: The Jackson House | 5BR Rental on 30A | Royal Destinations
meta_description: The Jackson House is a signature 5BR Old Seagrove home steps from Seaside. Enjoy a carriage house and semi-private beach. This 30A rental sleeps 10. Book today!
description_expanded: Description: The Jackson House by Royal Destinations Location: Old Seagrove Beach (Fronting 30A) Address: 22 Dogwood Street, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459 Details: The Jackson House is the quintessential 30A beach retreat — a timeless treasure nestled along the Emerald Coast, just steps from Seaside. Once home to author Harvey “Hardy” Jackson III, this beloved residence carries a rich history and has been thoughtfully reimagined from the ground up. Every inch has been renewed — from walls and floors to furnishings and finishes — while preserving the spirit of its storied past. A beautifully restored carriage house complete with a kitchen and bath adds even more charm and versatility. Enjoy access to a semi-private beach, a rare gem along 30A, where the rhythm of the waves sets the tone for effortless relaxation. Remodeled by renowned designer Jennifer James, The Jackson House blends heritage and modern coastal style — a place you’ll want to return to year after year. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: Across 30A -Parking Spaces: 3 -Dining Accommodations: 4 At Bar, 6 At Dining Table, 4 In Carriage House Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 10 5 Bedrooms / 3 Full Baths One Floor: - Guest Room 1: King Bed Semi-Private Bath with Twin Bunk Alcove in Family Suite - Guest Room 2: Twin Bunk Alcove in Family Suite-Semi-Private Bath - Guest Room 3: King Bed with Shared Bath - Guest Room 4: Queen Bed with Shared Bath - Kitchen / Living / Dining/ Laundry Carriage House: - Guest Bedroom 5: King Bed, Private Bath, 3/4 Kitchen Amenities Include: - 6 Adult Bikes - 1 Beach Service Set (Seasonal: March - October) Hardy Jacksons book “The Rise and Decline of the Redneck Riviera: An Insiders History of the Florida-Alabama Coast.” can be found at Sundog Books in Seaside or online. This book focuses on the history of the lower South’s vacation villages stretching from Mobile Bay to Panama City Beach. His residence was along 30A at 22 Dogwood Street. Please Note: *Nearby construction is underway. *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. *For a link to the virtual tour of the carriage house, please contact our office. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental.
